title: CAS Memory Ledger V0
description: JSON Schema for the V0 thin CAS-structured memory ledger. Used to store memories with cognitive annotations prior to V1 Graph migration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the memory record (e.g., mem_YYYYMMDD_XXXX).

content.description: The raw text or core semantic content of the memory.

summary.description: A brief, one-sentence summary of the memory content.

span.description: Line numbers or specific section within the source.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last memory update.

cas.description: CAS-specific cognitive metadata for indexing, retrieval, and lacunarity.

drives.description: Relevant Core Drives or Foundations for salience.

rpm_prerequisites.description: Required prior context or memory IDs needed to understand this memory.

omega_tags.description: Named emergent registers (Ω_*) attached to this memory.

production_roles.description: Roles this memory plays in production semantics (e.g., reagent, catalyst).

lacunarity_notes.description: Identified gaps or missing structures related to this memory.

confidence.description: Confidence in the accuracy of the CAS annotations [0.0, 1.0].

supersedes.description: List of older memory IDs this record replaces.

superseded_by.description: List of newer memory IDs that replace this record.

embedding_ref.description: Pointer to external vector embedding storage.
